description:
MOV MetaEdit is a tool that supports the embedding and editing of metadata in MOV (Apple QuickTime)
or MP4 (ISO/IEC 14496-14 a.k.a. MPEG-4 Part 14) files.

It is currently focused on Universal Ad ID metadata but could be expanded on request.

Sponsored by Ad-ID; designed, led and fully developed by MediaArea.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
